Register Newborn.description: Registers a newborn with NIA and mints a Ghana Card PIN, vouched for by a relative.

Get Registration By Baby PIN.description: Looks up one newborn registration by the minted baby PIN.
Get Registration By Baby PIN.code:
// Look up a registration by the baby's Ghana Card PIN.
get(`/awopa/api/v1/baby/registration/${$.data.babyPin}`);

List Registrations.description: Lists newborn registrations minted through the service.
List Registrations.code:
// List minted newborn registrations, e.g. to reconcile with the eTracker.
get('/awopa/api/v1/baby/registration');
